title: Naringenin protects swine testis cells from bisphenol A-induced apoptosis via Keap1/Nrf2 signaling pathway.
authors: Chen, Huijie; Chen, Jianqing; Shi, Xu; Li, Lu; Xu, Shiwen
one_liner_zh: 该文研究柚皮素通过Keap1/Nrf2通路保护猪睾丸细胞免受BPA诱导凋亡，核心为小分子-蛋白互作与细胞凋亡，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作、转录因子结合或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Bisphenol A (BPA) has caused serious pathologies in varying organs of humans and animals, especially reproductive organs. Naringenin (NRG) is a flavanone compound that has shown protective effects against several environmental chemicals through suppression of oxidative stress and activation of nuclear factor erythroid 2-related factor 2 (Nrf2) pathway. Herein, we described the discovery path of NRG inhibition on apoptosis in BPA exposed swine testis (ST) cells through targeting Kelch-like ech-associated protein (Keap1). We found that NRG could specifically bound to the active residues of DGR domain in Keap1, thereby activating Nrf2 signaling pathway, and then increasing the levels of SOD, GPx and CAT, and finally inhibiting oxidative stress and mitochondrial apoptosis induced by BPA in ST cells. Altogether, our results showed that NRG inhibits oxidative stress and mitochondrial apoptosis induced by BPA in ST cells by targeting Keap1/Nrf2 signaling pathway, indicating that NRG could serve as an antagonistic therapy against BPA.
abstract_zh: 双酚A（BPA）已在人类和动物的多个器官中引发严重病理变化，尤其是生殖器官。柚皮素（NRG）是一种黄烷酮类化合物，通过抑制氧化应激和激活核因子E2相关因子2（Nrf2）通路，已显示出对多种环境化学物质的保护作用。在此，我们描述了NRG通过靶向Kelch样ECH相关蛋白（Keap1）抑制BPA暴露的猪睾丸（ST）细胞凋亡的发现路径。我们发现NRG能特异性结合Keap1的DGR结构域中的活性残基，从而激活Nrf2信号通路，进而提高SOD、GPx和CAT的水平，最终抑制BPA诱导的ST细胞氧化应激和线粒体凋亡。总之，我们的结果表明，NRG通过靶向Keap1/Nrf2信号通路抑制BPA诱导的ST细胞氧化应激和线粒体凋亡，提示NRG可作为对抗BPA的拮抗疗法。
